title: AI and data centers have leapfrogged Israel, racism, and crypto as US campaign topics
summary: AI shows up in nearly 40 percent of all US races, ranking ahead of Israel, racism, and manufacturing as a campaign topic. Data centers and their impact on electricity costs and local resources drive most of the conversation.
